items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: I booked the band through Husk O'Hare.

ctx.x: So Dick Voynow got an offer to go with Brunswick records to be an A and R man there and to record different bands. So he says well, I tell you what we'll do kid, he says you can have the name the Wolverines and book the band. So what happened was we, I just got my, that was the band. Let me see, oh yes, there was Dave North at piano. On piano and then I mentioned the rest of the guys there.
I booked the band through Husk O'Hare. We were booked out...
Oh, that accounts for my seeing in print somewhere
